system.description:
A carpenter can select suitable trees, cut the lumber and use it to build structures, implements and furniture. Carpentry is a great way to replenish taxed Resources.

Obstacles: Simple box or shelf, Ob 1. Cup, bowl, stool, ladder: Ob 2. Wall, table, chair, cabinets: Ob 3. A slatted floor, Ob 4. A wooden staircase, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Engineer, Carving

Skill Type: Craftsman. Tools: Workshop

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 263
